title: Session 8: Creating a CRUD Application Using ReactJS Forms

questions.questionText: What does CRUD stand for?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Create, Read, Update, Delete.

questions.questionText: Which HTTP method is used for the Create operation in CRUD?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) POST.

questions.questionText: Which HTTP method is used for the Read operation in CRUD?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) GET.

questions.questionText: Which HTTP method is used for the Update operation in the session's CRUD app?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) PUT.

questions.questionText: Which HTTP method is used for the Delete operation in CRUD?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) DELETE.

questions.questionText: Which statement about CRUD is correct as per the session?
options: CRUD is used only in databases
Any feature in an app requires one of the four CRUD operations
CRUD applies only to mobile apps
questions.correctAnswer: Any feature in an app requires one of the four CRUD operations
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Any feature in an app requires one of the four CRUD operations.

questions.questionText: Which starter code does the session CRUD application begin with?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The code from Session 5 (session8_starter.zip).

questions.questionText: Which Visual Studio Code feature is used to move a component to its own file?
options: Move to a new file (via the bulb icon)
questions.correctAnswer: Move to a new file (via the bulb icon)
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Move to a new file (via the bulb icon).

questions.questionText: Which service is used in the session to mock the API and data?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) mockapi.io.

questions.questionText: Which JavaScript method is used to request data from the API in UserList?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) fetch.

questions.questionText: Which hook is used to call the API only once, at mount, in UserList?
options: useEffect with an empty dependency array
questions.correctAnswer: useEffect with an empty dependency array
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) useEffect with an empty dependency array.

questions.questionText: Why does the console run twice in development even with useEffect([])?
options: StrictMode renders components twice in development, but only once in production
questions.correctAnswer: StrictMode renders components twice in development, but only once in production
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) StrictMode renders components twice in development, but only once in production.

questions.questionText: Which hook stores the fetched users so they are displayed on screen?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) useState (via setUsers).

questions.questionText: What is the initial value given to useState for the users list?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) An empty array [].

questions.questionText: In UserList, why is id={usr.id} passed to the User component instead of the index?
options: So the URL uses the actual user id from the API
questions.correctAnswer: So the URL uses the actual user id from the API
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) So the URL uses the actual user id from the API.

questions.questionText: How does UserDetail get the id of the user from the URL?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) useParams().

questions.questionText: What is the initial value of the user state in UserDetail?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) An empty object {}.

questions.questionText: In the session, how is the Delete button passed to the User component?
options: Created directly inside the User component
As JSX passed through the deleteButton prop
questions.correctAnswer: As JSX passed through the deleteButton prop
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) As JSX passed through the deleteButton prop.

questions.questionText: What is the pattern of passing JSX as props, such as deleteButton, known as?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Render props.

questions.questionText: What is the advantage of passing the Delete button JSX as a prop from UserList?
options: It removes the need for props
The button has access to all the variables inside UserList
questions.correctAnswer: The button has access to all the variables inside UserList
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The button has access to all the variables inside UserList.

questions.questionText: Which method is used inside fetch to delete a user?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) DELETE.

questions.questionText: How is the user list refreshed after deletion?
options: By refreshing the browser manually only
By calling the function that fetches users again inside deleteUser
questions.correctAnswer: By calling the function that fetches users again inside deleteUser
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) By calling the function that fetches users again inside deleteUser.

questions.questionText: In the session, a separate function that fetches users is called in useEffect and also in:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) deleteUser.

questions.questionText: To add a user, which route and page are created?
options: A separate page (e.g., /users/add) with an AddUser component
questions.correctAnswer: A separate page (e.g., /users/add) with an AddUser component
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) A separate page (e.g., /users/add) with an AddUser component.

questions.questionText: Why must newUser data be stringified before sending in the POST request?
options: The body must be passed as JSON text to the fetch method
questions.correctAnswer: The body must be passed as JSON text to the fetch method
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The body must be passed as JSON text to the fetch method.

questions.questionText: Which JavaScript method converts an object to a JSON string?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) JSON.stringify().

questions.questionText: Which libraries are used to simplify complex forms and validations?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) formik and yup.

questions.questionText: What is the role of formik?
options: Simplifies the form model and integration for adding validations
questions.correctAnswer: Simplifies the form model and integration for adding validations
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Simplifies the form model and integration for adding validations.

questions.questionText: What is the role of yup?
options: Makes it easy to add validations to the form
questions.correctAnswer: Makes it easy to add validations to the form
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Makes it easy to add validations to the form.

questions.questionText: Which hook from formik is used to manage the form model?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) useFormik.

questions.questionText: In useFormik, which option provides the form model's starting values?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) initialValues.

questions.questionText: Why is the name attribute required on every input when using formik.handleChange?
options: So formik can identify which field is being updated
questions.correctAnswer: So formik can identify which field is being updated
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) So formik can identify which field is being updated.

questions.questionText: Why do built-in validations such as required not trigger when inputs are not inside a form element?
options: Validation is triggered only for inputs surrounded by a form element on submit
questions.correctAnswer: Validation is triggered only for inputs surrounded by a form element on submit
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Validation is triggered only for inputs surrounded by a form element on submit.

questions.questionText: Which function must be set on the form's onSubmit to let formik take over submission?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) formik.handleSubmit.

questions.questionText: Which option of useFormik receives the yup schema?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) validationSchema.

questions.questionText: What does the validationSchema ensure?
options: The onSubmit callback is called only when all validations pass
questions.correctAnswer: The onSubmit callback is called only when all validations pass
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The onSubmit callback is called only when all validations pass.

questions.questionText: In the userValidationSchema, how is the pic field validated?
options: It must be at least 10 characters
It must be a string, a valid URL, and required
questions.correctAnswer: It must be a string, a valid URL, and required
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) It must be a string, a valid URL, and required.

questions.questionText: In the userValidationSchema, what is required of the bio field?
options: A string of at least 10 characters that is required
questions.correctAnswer: A string of at least 10 characters that is required
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) A string of at least 10 characters that is required.

questions.questionText: Which formik property holds the validation error messages?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) formik.errors.

questions.questionText: Why are error messages displayed prematurely when the user starts typing in any field?
options: All errors are shown without tracking whether each field was touched
questions.correctAnswer: All errors are shown without tracking whether each field was touched
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) All errors are shown without tracking whether each field was touched.

questions.questionText: When is the onBlur event triggered?
options: When a user clicks on the field and then clicks outside of it
questions.correctAnswer: When a user clicks on the field and then clicks outside of it
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) When a user clicks on the field and then clicks outside of it.

questions.questionText: Which formik handler is provided to onBlur?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) formik.handleBlur.

questions.questionText: Which JavaScript technique is used to simplify formik.handleSubmit into handleSubmit?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Destructuring.

questions.questionText: How is the Edit button navigation set up for a user?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) navigate to /users/edit/:id.

questions.questionText: Why are the form fields empty when the fetched data is used directly in initialValues of the same component?
options: The data takes time to load and initialValues is already set with undefined values
questions.correctAnswer: The data takes time to load and initialValues is already set with undefined values
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The data takes time to load and initialValues is already set with undefined values.

questions.questionText: How is the problem of delayed data fixed in EditUser?
options: By splitting into EditUser and EditUserForm and rendering the form only when data is available
questions.correctAnswer: By splitting into EditUser and EditUserForm and rendering the form only when data is available
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) By splitting into EditUser and EditUserForm and rendering the form only when data is available.

questions.questionText: What is displayed while the user data is being fetched in EditUser?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Loading....

questions.questionText: Which initial value is used for the user state in EditUser so that "Loading..." can be shown?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) null.

questions.questionText: Which HTTP method is used in the updateUser function?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) PUT.

questions.questionText: Which method is used to confirm a successful update and then navigate back to /users?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) .then(() => navigate("/users")).
